'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Bobby Hilbun LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bobby Hilbun]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)|Communing]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
